mentions.name: Story time app
mentions.description: A story time app for reading to children that started with reading tracking and personal library recommendations and expanded to include book discovery and ebook reading via OpenLibrary. A 1.0 release is planned for May on iOS and Android.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m getting ready for the first release of a story time app my wife and I have been using for reading to our son.

The scope creeped to book discovery and ebook reading with OpenLibrary from just tracking and personal library recommendations.
